load_model_config: load the Hugging Face model config from a model path with optional trust remote code and revision
load_model_tokenizer: load a tokenizer from a Hugging Face model path with optional trust remote code and tokenizer revision
load_model_processor: load a multimodal processor from a Hugging Face model path with optional trust remote code and revision
download_model_files: download model files from Hugging Face Hub with optional allow patterns for selective file retrieval
get_context_length: get the context length from a Hugging Face model config object
check_gguf_file: check if a model path points to a GGUF format file
normalize_rope_scaling: normalize rope scaling config for compatibility with SGLang inference
